alert_news.title: Mysuru Planetarium Opens as India's First LED Curved-Dome Facility
bullets: India’s first LED curved‑dome planetarium, Cosmos‑Mysuru, located at the foothills of Chamundi Hill, Mysuru
Built by the Union Department of Science and Technology as a cosmology education and research training centre
Inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 13‑14 November 2026

alert_news.title: India's Journey of Discovery and Innovation in Space
bullets: India’s first indigenous sounding rocket launched in 1967, following the 1963 research rocket from Thumba
Marked the start of India’s indigenous launch capability, paving the way for missions like Chandrayaan‑3 and Mangalyaan

alert_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates India's First LED Dome Planetarium in Mysuru
bullets: India's first LED dome planetarium, Cosmos Mysuru, located in Mysuru, Karnataka, inaugurated by PM Modi.
Built by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics and the University of Mysore, it enhances the country’s scientific and educational infrastructure.

alert_news.title: G Kishan Reddy Launches Critical Minerals Research Hub And India's First VR Mine Training Facility
bullets: India's first Virtual Reality-based mine simulator, inaugurated at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad under the National Critical Minerals Mission.
The Centre of Excellence for Critical Minerals serves as a national platform for advanced research and scalable industry solutions.

alert_news.title: India's first day-care bilateral hip replacement performed at Delhi hospital
bullets: India’s first same‑day bilateral total hip replacement using Smart AI Navigation performed at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, Delhi, led by Dr Sujoy Bhattacharjee
40‑year‑old patient from Myanmar, 3.5‑hour surgery, uncemented Meril Libertas implants, patient mobilised within 4 hours and discharged on the same day

alert_news.title: IIM Bangalore Becomes India's First IGBC Platinum-Certified Educational Institution
bullets: IIM Bangalore is the first educational institution in India to receive IGBC Platinum certification under the Green Campus Rating System Version 1.0.
The Platinum level requires 80–100 points, indicating the highest sustainability performance in energy efficiency, water conservation, renewable energy, waste management, and occupant well‑being.

alert_news.title: Science, spirituality go hand-in-hand in India, says PM Modi while opening India's first LED ...
bullets: Mysuru University campus inaugurated India's first LED Dome planetarium, located in Mysuru, Karnataka.
The LED Dome uses advanced LED technology for immersive planetarium displays, marking the first of its kind in India.

alert_news.title: IIM Bangalore gets IGBC Platinum Green Campus certification
bullets: IIM Bangalore is the first educational institution in India to receive IGBC Platinum Green Campus certification under the IGBC Green Campus Rating System Version 1.0.
The campus features 350 kWp rooftop solar capacity, a 500 KLD sewage treatment plant, and extensive rainwater harvesting and groundwater recharge facilities.

alert_news.title: What is COSMOS-Mysuru? How India's first LED dome planetarium will help students explore space
bullets: COSMOS‑Mysuru, located on the University of Mysore campus, is India's first LED dome planetarium built by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics.
The 15‑metre tilted dome contains ~6,150 LED panels with 4.2 crore LEDs, delivering 8K resolution for immersive astronomy education.

alert_news.title: India's first Youth Olympics gold in boxing won by Manipur boxer
bullets: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei became the first Indian boxer to win a Youth Olympics gold medal in the 50 kg category at Dakar 2026
Defeated Ireland's Jubani Kristian 3‑2 in the final, securing India's first gold at the Youth Olympic Games
The victory raised India's overall Youth Olympics medal tally to nine, placing the country ninth in the standings

alert_news.title: India's First Research Rocket and Indigenous Sounding Rocket
bullets: India's first research rocket carrying instruments to study the upper atmosphere was launched from Thumba, Kerala on 21 November 1963.
India's first indigenous sounding rocket was launched in 1967, carrying scientific instruments into the upper atmosphere.
Chandrayaan‑3 became the first Indian mission to reach the Moon's southern high‑latitude region on 23 August 2023.

alert_news.title: India's First 'Amrit Bharat 3.0' Train Departs From New Delhi To Patna
bullets: First Amrit Bharat 3.0 train flagged off from New Delhi to Patna on 11 November 2026 by Indian Railways.
Equipped with push‑pull technology, modern toilets, mobile charging points, designed for common and middle‑class passengers.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad's Panjagutta to become India's first AI Police Station
bullets: India’s first AI‑based police station at Panjagutta Police Station, Hyderabad, developed by Hyderabad City Police under Telangana DGP
Pilot project integrates AI across all functions – complaint registration, FIR, case diary, investigation reports, charge sheet, and multilingual ‘Setu’ kiosk

alert_news.title: India Secures First Rifle Quota for LA 2028
bullets: India earned its first Olympic rifle quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Games through Niraj Kumar’s bronze medal at the ISSF World Championship in Doha.
The quota was secured in the men’s 50m rifle 3‑positions event, marking India’s first qualification in this rifle discipline for the Olympics.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad to Launch India’s First AI‑Powered Police Station
bullets: Hyderabad’s Panjagutta police station will become India’s first AI‑powered police station, with a pilot launch planned for the first week of December 2026.
The pilot, directed by Telangana DGOP, will employ AI for complaint registration, FIR filing, case diary maintenance, investigation reports and charge‑sheet preparation.

alert_news.title: Niraj Kumar wins bronze at ISSF World Championship, secures India's first rifle quota for LA 2028
bullets: India's first rifle quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics earned by Niraj Kumar at the ISSF World Championship in Doha.
Quota secured in men's 50m rifle 3 positions event; India's total Olympic quotas now two.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad AI Police Station Pilot to Launch in Panjagutta - Urban Acres
bullets: India's first AI-powered police station to be launched at Panjagutta, Hyderabad, pilot scheduled for December 2026.
Initiated by Telangana Police under DG C.V. Anand; includes AI-enabled Setu kiosk for complaint registration in 10 languages.

alert_news.title: India’s First Shooting Quota for the 2028 Olympics Secured by Jaypal Malviya
bullets: India secured its first Olympic shooting quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Games through Jaypal Malviya, a shooter from Madhya Pradesh.
The quota was earned at the ISSF World Championship in Doha, marking the first time India has qualified a shooter for the 2028 Olympics.
